title: 第25章 地下城第26章 新的打法
slug: 请不要给基础技能附魔奇怪的词条

“哐当——轰！”
伴随着一声令人牙酸的金属撞击声，巨大的蒸汽活塞喷出一股灼热的白雾，绞盘上的粗大铁链开始缓缓转动。
维克多站在一个足以容纳十辆马车的巨型铁笼升降梯内，感受着脚下传来的明显失重感。
随着升降梯的下沉，头顶那属于凛风城午后的阳光迅速收缩成一个刺眼的光斑，直至完全消失。取而代之的，是周围岩壁上镶嵌的炼金壁灯所散发出的幽幽蓝光。
空气开始变得湿润且带着一股铁锈和硫磺混合的味道。
“这就是凛风城繁荣的根基，‘九曲地渊’地下城。”
入目之处，是一座仿佛被巨人凿开的恢弘洞窟。数百年的拓宽工程让这里的空间大得惊人，高达五十米的穹顶隐没在昏暗的灯火中，给人一种深不见底的错觉。
根据哈蒙的说法，目前他所处的还是地下一层，这个地下城共有九层。
从地下二层开始，就会出现会涌现魔物的空间节点。因为这些节点是单向的，所以没人知道这些魔物到底来自哪个位面。
“所以，凛风城其实是建在一个高压锅盖上的。”维克多在心里吐槽，“而这些冒险者，就是负责给高压锅放气的阀门。”
升降梯运行了大约三分钟，终于在一阵刺耳的刹车声中停了下来。
“地下一层，到了。请快速离开升降机。”
负责看守升降梯的是一名穿着重甲的城卫军，他手持长戟，目光警惕地扫视着铁笼里的众人。
维克多走出铁笼，脚踩在坚硬的黑岩地面上。
这里是地下一层的中转平台，也是最接近地表的安全区。营地外几个地精商贩正缩在角落里兜售着劣质的荧光石。
维克多紧了紧腰间的空间行囊。
这是他刚刚在冒险者协会接取的委托——【补给运送：运送空间行囊至地下二层灰鼠营地】。
报酬是1枚银币。
说实话，这点钱连买两支精铁箭都不够。但这任务有个巨大的隐藏福利：持有协会委托凭证的职业者，可以免除进入地下城的“过路费”。

“进来一次就要50铜币，直接就省下一天房费！”
这条道路其实非常安全，甚至黑铁级冒险者就能完成。但是领主府依然限制了仅有职业者可以承接。主要是因为这个有将近100方体积的空间行囊价值不菲。
普通的冒险者跑了追查起来非常麻烦，但是如果是在职的职业者，哪怕职业者能跑掉，但是所属的职业公会总是在的。横跨六大王国的职业公会也不会放过这个瘪孙。
他辨认了一下方向。
从这里到通往地下二层的升降梯入口，大约有十公里的路程。这段路被称为“灰岩回廊”，是地下一层的主干道，虽然没有大规模的魔物群，但偶尔会有从下层溜上来的漏网之鱼。
他这次主要是熟悉一下这个地下城的环境。据说这里有机会能碰到落单的三阶魔物。他手里正有两个新技能正嗷嗷待哺呢。
尽管任务有时间限制，但整整五个小时的余量显得绰绰有余。离开一层营地后，维克多有意放慢了行进速度，毕竟第一次来，小心为上。
正在这时。
“吱吱——！”
侧前方的一处废弃矿洞中，突然窜出一道黑影。
那是一只体型足有土狗大小的变异矿鼠，浑身长满了坚硬的灰色角质层，猩红的眼睛死死盯着正在飞奔的维克多。它显然把这个落单的人类当成了猎物。
若是以前，维克多大概会停下来，拉弓射箭，甚至还要考虑风向。

"Bang-dang-boom!"
Accompanied by a heart-wrenching metal collision, the huge steam piston sprayed out a stream of hot white mist, and the thick iron chain on the winch began to rotate slowly.
Victor stood in a giant iron cage elevator that could accommodate ten carriages, feeling the obvious weightlessness under his feet.
As the elevator sank, the afternoon sunlight in Howling City above the head quickly shrank into a dazzling light spot until it completely disappeared. Instead, there is the faint blue light emitted by the alchemy wall lamps inlaid on the surrounding rock walls.
The air became humid and smelled of rust and sulfur.
"This is the foundation of the prosperity of Howling City, the 'Nine Curved Abyss' underground city."
The first thing you see is a majestic cave that seems to have been carved out by giants. Hundreds of years of widening projects have made the space here incredibly large. The fifty-meter-high dome is hidden in the dim lights, giving people the illusion of being bottomless.
According to Harmon, he is currently on the underground level. There are nine floors in this underground city.
Starting from the second underground floor, there will be space nodes where monsters emerge. Because these nodes are one-way, no one knows which plane these monsters come from.
"So, Howling City is actually built on the lid of a pressure cooker." Victor complained in his mind, "And these adventurers are the valves responsible for deflating the pressure cooker."
The elevator ran for about three minutes and finally stopped with a harsh brake sound.
"Basement level, we're here. Please get out of the elevator quickly."
The person responsible for guarding the elevator was a city guard wearing heavy armor. He was holding a halberd and scanning the people in the iron cage with vigilant eyes.
Victor stepped out of the iron cage and stepped on the hard black rock ground.
This is the transfer platform on the underground level and the safe area closest to the surface. Outside the camp, several goblin vendors were huddled in the corner selling low-quality fluorescent stones.
Victor tightened the space bag around his waist.
This is the commission he just accepted from the Adventurers Association - [Supply Delivery: Transport space luggage to the Gray Rat Camp on the second underground floor].
The reward is 1 silver coin.
To be honest, this amount of money is not even enough to buy two fine iron arrows. But this mission has a huge hidden benefit: professionals who hold association entrustment certificates can be exempted from the "toll" to enter the dungeon.
"It only costs 50 copper coins to come in, which directly saves the room fee for a day!"
This road is actually very safe and even a Black Iron level adventurer can complete it. However, the Lord's Mansion still restricted that only professionals could undertake it. Mainly because this space luggage with a volume of nearly 100 square meters is worth a lot of money.
It would be very troublesome to track down ordinary adventurers if they run away, but if it is a working professional, even if the professional can run away, the professional guild to which he belongs will always be there. The professional guilds across the six kingdoms will not let this scoundrel go.
He identified the direction.
It is about ten kilometers from here to the entrance of the elevator to the second underground floor. This section of the road is called the "Greystone Corridor" and is the main road on the underground level. Although there are no large groups of monsters, there are occasionally fish that slip up from the lower level.
This time he mainly wanted to familiarize himself with the environment of this dungeon. It is said that there is a chance to encounter a lone third-level monster here. He has two new skills waiting for him.
Although the mission has a time limit, a full five hours seems more than enough. After leaving the first-level camp, Victor deliberately slowed down his speed. After all, it was his first time here, so it was better to be careful.
At this moment.
"Zhizhi——!"
A black shadow suddenly emerged from an abandoned mine in front of him.
It was a mutated mining rat that was about the size of a native dog. Its body was covered with hard gray cuticles, and its scarlet eyes stared intently at Victor as he was running. It obviously regards this lone human being asBecame prey.
If it were before, Victor would probably stop, draw his bow and shoot an arrow, even considering the direction of the wind.
